instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Keep one request that arrived, as decided, and ask the owner who should act on it", and give it request; decision.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:take-a-request and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: request is what arrived: request_id, source_ref, atom_ref, text, origin_ref, optionally message_ref, content_revision and at.

4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: intake-origins (records:read); intake-owner (records:read); intake-request (records:read, records:write); owner-action-request (records:read, records:write).
